scope: synthetic comparison of three reduced models under one declared protocol; no clinical calibration

units.flexibility: dimensionless, recoverable/total; null where total is 0
units.b(t): dimensionless loading-asymmetry index; b=1 is the declared reference asymmetry that yields recoverable deviation kappa_e0 with no growth

growth_history: recovery_ratchet.growth_velocity(t) for every model; 'ceasing_at_18' multiplies by 0.5*(1-tanh((t-18)/0.25))

unload_at_14.why: recovery_ratchet.simulate has no load input, no growth-history argument and a fixed zero initial state

growth_ceases_at_18.why: recovery_ratchet.simulate has no load input, no growth-history argument and a fixed zero initial state

unload_at_14_growth_ceases_at_18.why: recovery_ratchet.simulate has no load input, no growth-history argument and a fixed zero initial state

reverse_load_at_14.why: recovery_ratchet.simulate has no load input, no growth-history argument and a fixed zero initial state

reverse_load_at_18_growth_ceases_at_18.why: recovery_ratchet.simulate has no load input, no growth-history argument and a fixed zero initial state

correction.a_ratchet_api: not expressible: dkappa_p/dt >= 0 by construction and no reverse term
correction.c_no_autonomous_reverse_term: the Stokes law G=G_m(1-beta(sigma-sigma_m)) reverses wedging only when the net stress asymmetry reverses while G_m>0; no kh analogue

zero_bias_population.forcing: b(t)=sum_k a_k cos(2 pi f_k t + phi_k)/sqrt(8), a~N(0,1), f~U(0.25,1.5)/yr, phi~U(0,2pi)
zero_bias_population.a_ratchet_api: not expressible: kappa_e0 is a fixed magnitude, i.e. rectified by construction

b_two_state_kh0.note: API pins rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12; only max_step can be tightened

sensitivity.design: one-at-a-time x0.5 and x1.5 on kr, kg_peak, beta, c_load; outputs from the baseline and unload_at_14 protocols; relative change vs reference
sensitivity.degeneracy_note: in (c) beta, G_m_peak, c_sigma and 1/(w h) enter only through lam_peak, so a factor on beta is a factor on any of them; in (b) c_load scales every output linearly by construction

a_ratchet_law.beta: not a parameter of this model
a_ratchet_law.c_load: not a parameter of this model

b_two_state_kh0.beta: not a parameter of this model

c_stress_growth.kr: not a parameter of this model
c_stress_growth.kg_peak: not a parameter of this model
c_stress_growth.c_load: not a parameter of this model

a_ratchet: dkappa_p/dt >= 0 whenever kappa_e0 >= 0: kappa_p monotone, flexibility monotone falling
kappa_e0 is a fixed unsigned magnitude: the load is a deviation amplitude, not a load, and the sign is rectified
event-rate multiplier nu = kg: rate is kg*kappa_e0*kg/(kr+kg), i.e. kg/kr times the (b) quasi-steady rate kg*e_ss with e_ss = kr*kappa_e0/(kr+kg)
no onset threshold at kg = kr (smooth in kg)
no recovery and no reverse term
growth_velocity has a 0.074 baseline at age 20, so set accumulates indefinitely
b_two_state: linear in the forcing: zero bias gives zero, reversal mirrors, output scales with c_load
e relaxes at kr+kg, so recoverable deviation is smaller during growth by construction
with kh = 0 p is monotone under one-signed forcing; kh > 0 is a declared, not derived, term
no onset threshold; no anatomy, no handedness, no 3D
c_stress_growth: dkappa_w/dt = lam(t)*kappa_total with lam > 0 whenever beta*c_sigma > 0 and G_m > 0: exponential-type positive feedback with no threshold in this linearisation
elastic seed kappa_e0*b(t) is quasi-static: unloading removes it instantly
no recovery variable and no reverse term; correction needs a reversed net stress asymmetry during remaining growth
one-DOF linearisation of the Stokes law, not his finite-element geometry

discriminating_under_identical_protocol.statement: the sign and time course of structural change after a load change, and whether the recoverable part decays over years or vanishes instantly, differ between models under the same protocol; the falling flexibility under sustained load does not
